# Hi, I'm Jordi

**Senior Data Engineer** based in Barcelona, focused on data platforms, ELT pipelines, MLOps, and putting generative AI into production. 10+ years building data infrastructure, with a background in physics and energy engineering.

I enjoy turning messy, high-stakes data problems into systems that are reliable, observable, and built to last.
